mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods with declining INDPRO, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and federal funds rate signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,200,000 units, it signals strong consumer confidence and rising home purchases, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
